title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.OPS #AGENT-SCOREBOARD: Per-agent and per-harness quality scoreboard from intake attribution
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/controlplane.js
code-anchor: export async function companionBrief

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.OPS
**Metric it should move:** readers
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call (fleet_budget cap is breached; cost 426.89 vs 300).
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::agent_scoreboard ; merged and verified live (VERIFY-LIVE-1) with a probe the author did not write
**Status:** closed

Using the agent/harness field on intake items (AGENT-HARNESS-1), report per agent: items submitted, accepted, declined, time to triage, merged PRs. Register it in qnfo-audit.metric_registry with a trigger. Prediction: shows which agent/harness yields the most accepted work; a routing weight follows.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 168.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
